scripts.build: bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs sync --profile=development --target=frontend --quiet && NODE_ENV=development vue-tsc -b && NODE_ENV=development vite build --mode development
scripts.build:prod: bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs sync --profile=production --target=frontend --quiet && bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs check --profile=production --target=frontend --quiet && NODE_ENV=production vue-tsc -b && NODE_ENV=production vite build --mode production
scripts.build:watch: bun ../scripts/dev-env.mjs sync --profile=development --target=frontend --quiet && NODE_ENV=development vite build --watch --mode development
scripts.lint: bun run format && bun run eslint && bun run stylelint
